name: The Lady Most Wicked: Side Story 03
source:
Victoria Revelle is your standard reincarnated villainess who must navigate between the lines of mystery, romance, and murder. But what if she regained her memories later in life, instead of when she was a child?

[From [url=https://fableknot.itch.io/lady-most-wicked03]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
维多利亚·雷维尔是一名标准的转生恶役千金，平日里不得不在悬疑、恋爱与谋杀的夹缝间小心周旋。但如果她并非在幼年时便觉醒前世记忆，而是直到长大后才突然想起来，又会发生什么呢？

[摘自[url=https://fableknot.itch.io/lady-most-wicked03]itch.io[/url]]
